translation.name: Nasoruan siGot len nasoruan ta Uluveu

book.name: Nauman gail
book.title: Nauman gail Nǝsa ahai pispisul gail lotogole

content: Loriŋ nǝvanuan emǝlevru hǝn lǝb̃ekǝtkǝta tǝban nǝbatunau pǝhaṽut gail

Len nǝboŋ galenan ahai susur gail, alat lotokad nadǝlomian, lusob̃sob̃ur am. Ale naJu gail lotosor len nasoruan ta Kris lukoblen ke, alat lotosor len nasoruan Ipru lǝsapǝpehun nǝhanian sanor len nǝbatunau pǝhaṽut lotosor len nasoruan ta Kris.

Imagenan, ahai pispisul tosǝŋavur pisan toru lokis nǝvanuan nadǝlomian p̃isi logǝm b̃onb̃on beti luke, “Sanor hǝn ginamit namtb̃eriŋ gab̃ulan na-kel-uri-an hǝn nasoruan siGot hǝn namtb̃epǝpehun nǝhanian.
Bathudud gail mitilekis hǝn temǝlevru len gamit lotopul hǝn aNunun aGot mai namitisau hǝn nǝmauran tonor. Ale dereh namteriŋ galit hǝn lǝb̃igol nauman egai.
Ale ginamit dereh namtb̃idaŋ len na-sor-tuṽ-an mai na-kel-uri-an hǝn nasoruan siGot.”

Galit p̃isi lohǝhaṽur hǝn nǝnauan sihai pispisul gail. Lulekis hǝn aSteven, aulum̃an sua topul hǝn nadǝlomian mai aNunun aGot. Beti lulekis hǝn aFilip, aProkorus, aNikanor, aTimon, aParmenas mai aNikolas ta Antiok togǝm vi Ju.
Naluṽoh losǝhar galit gǝm hǝn ahai pispisul gail, ale ahai pispisul lusor tuṽ m̃os galit lotomǝlevru, loriŋ navǝlalito len nǝkadulito hǝn lǝb̃igol nauman enan.
Ŋa nasoruan siGot husur aYesu iperperŋan naut. Ahai susur len naut a Jerusalem nasob̃uran halito evi mǝhat tutut, ale ahai tutumav isob̃ur lugol husur nǝsa nap̃usanan siYesu tokele.
AGot eviol masuṽ hǝn navoian mai nǝdaŋan mai aSteven. Ale aSteven igol namerikel tǝban nǝvanuan gail. Lumaŋmaŋ len namerikel galenan ale nǝdaŋan siGot imasil len gail.
Be nǝvanuan galevis lusor tas aSteven. Galito lovi Ju hǝn naluṽoh sua lokisi hǝn Naim Nab̃onb̃onan seFriman.
Lovi Ju ta Sairin, ta Aleksadria, ta Silisia, ta Asia, ale loil, lusor b̃alb̃al mai aSteven.
Be nǝboŋ tosor, aNunun aGot eviol hǝn namitisau hǝn nǝmauran tonor maii, gol ke lodǝdas lǝb̃isor vari.
Ale galito lusor utaut mai nǝvanuan galevis hǝn lǝb̃isor tas aSteven ke, “Namtosǝsǝloŋ hǝn atenan tosor mǝdas aMoses mai aGot!”
Imagenan lugol nǝvanuan gail nǝlolit ipaŋpaŋ, galit mai alat lotoil a m̃o hǝn galito mai ahai p̃usan gail hǝn nalo. Beti lutah gat aSteven, lugol eil len nǝhon nǝSanhitrin.
Ale losǝhar nǝvanuan galevis vi rivuh hǝn lǝb̃elibliboŋ. Luke, “Akis ategai isor tas naim egai tolo mai nalo siMoses.
Husur namtosǝsǝloŋ hǝni toke aYesu ta Nasaret egaii dereh tigol naut egai timasirsir ale tegǝgel hǝn naṽide aMoses tolav mai gidato ta sutuai.”
Alat lotobǝtah len nǝSanhitrin lokǝta bunus aSteven, loris ke nǝhon egǝm sum̃an nǝhon aŋel.

footnotes.text: 6.9 Friman lovi alat lotovi slev a m̃o be lǝsavi slev am.
